title: Compiled Python bytecode still tracked in git (still present since round 3)
detail: Build artifact committed in tree; regenerated bytecode may silently diverge from the checked-in .py derivation record.
recommended_fix: git rm --cached the .pyc and add __pycache__/ to .gitignore.

title: settings_save_at writes via a predictable '<path>.tmp' then renames over the target (still present since round 6)
detail: No O_EXCL on a predictable temp name in $HOME: a pre-planted symlink at .pp-settings.bin.tmp redirects the write. Low impact (non-secret 6-byte settings).
recommended_fix: Include crypto-random bytes in the tmp suffix before the rename.

title: settings_load_at reads the entire dotfile before any size bound (still present since round 5)
evidence:
data, err := os.read_entire_file_from_path(path, context.temp_allocator)
	if err != nil || len(data) < 6 {
detail: A multi-gigabyte file at ~/.pp-settings.bin is fully allocated before the length check. Only bounds from below; no upper bound.
recommended_fix: os.file_size first and reject files larger than 6 bytes with the defaults fallback.
